name: programmed cell death 1 ligand 2

function.text: PDCD1LG2 encodes programmed cell death 1 ligand 2. Annotated molecular activities include receptor ligand activity. It participates in immune response and negative regulation of interleukin-10 production.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Classic Hodgkin lymphoma; Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
